stem:
Priya wants to measure the length of the curved edge of a round steel plate in her kitchen. She has only a straight metre scale and a piece of thread.
Which method will give the correct length of the curved edge?

options.text: Measure the straight distance between the two ends of the curved edge with the metre scale.
Lay the thread along the curved edge, then straighten the thread and measure its length with the metre scale.
Estimate the length by eye, because a curve cannot be measured.
Measure the diameter of the plate and take that as the length of the curved edge.

teacher.key_rationale: A curved edge is measured by laying a flexible thread along it, then straightening the thread and measuring it with a metre scale; the straight gap between the ends or the diameter does not equal the curved length.
